tuning.note: Reviewer-strengthened particle filter. Astra fixed particles=512 (never tuned; median min-ESS 3%). This search uses 4096 particles on untouched hard_val[160:224] (not used by tuning, thresholds, cue probes or checkpoint selection). Tracking runs once per (q, miss); bandwidth only changes the output KDE, so all bandwidths are scored on the same particles. r fixed at 1 (Astra optimum). Kalman settings copied unchanged from t2_tuning_ac.json. Selection: mean per-sequence all-frame NLL. Bandwidth 0.5 is the lower edge of this grid.
